sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for appellant that appellant is in jail since 12.08.2023.
Prosecutrix has been examined in Court and she is hostile.
Now, there is no chances that applicant will be able to tamper with evidence or influence witnesses.

In these circumstances,
prayer is made to release appellant on bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the appeal for grant of bail.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties.
6.
Considering the period of custody and the fact that prosecutrix has turned hostile, criminal appeal filed by appellant is allowed.

7. It is directed that on appellant's furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned, he be released on bail.
9. Prosecution is at liberty to take action against the prosecutrix in accordance with law.
10. C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
